text.content: DeepSearchQA explicitly evaluates multi-step research on systematic collation, deduplication/entity resolution, and stopping criteria, and reports persistent weaknesses in balancing recall and precision. BrowseComp similarly emphasizes persistence, strategic browsing, and synthesis across many sites.
